title.zh: 博通为Anthropic芯片采购安排融资并提供贷款
title.en: Broadcom arranges financing and extends loans for Anthropic chip purchases

current_state.zh: 博通正在安排一项600亿美元的AI芯片融资方案，其中包括420亿美元的高级担保债务和由黑石集团牵头的180亿美元次级债务，Anthropic是受益方之一。
current_state.en: Broadcom is arranging a $60 billion AI chip financing package, including $42B in senior secured debt and $18B in subordinated debt led by Blackstone, with Anthropic among the beneficiaries.

updates.title_zh: 博通已同意向Anthropic提供最高420亿美元贷款

updates.what_changed_zh: 博通已同意向Anthropic提供最高420亿美元的贷款，用于为这家AI实验室的基础设施支出提供资金。
updates.what_changed_en: Broadcom has agreed to extend up to $42 billion in loans to Anthropic to finance the AI lab's infrastructure spending.
